the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: Take the maximal slice g : U' to U of the max-slice lemma. Since h^{-1}(u) = F'_u and dim_{e(u)}(F'_u) = dim(G'_u) = 0 under local quasi-finiteness of G to U, h has relative dimension at most 0 at (u, e(u)); the local-source-apply remark yields the maximal open U'' of U' containing u on which h has relative dimension at most 0, and after replacing U' by U'' the morphism h has relative dimension at most 0 everywhere. A morphism locally of finite presentation of relative dimension at most 0 is locally quasi-finite (morphisms locally-quasi-finite-rel-dimension-0 lemma), so h, still locally of finite presentation and Cohen-Macaulay, is flat, locally of finite presentation and locally quasi-finite, proving (4); the restrict-property lemma transfers this to s' and t' of the restriction as base changes of h, proving (5).
